text: NEWS: Trump admin supports a draft bill that would impose heavy financial penalties on purchasers of Russian oil, adding to economic pressure on Moscow, all in an effort to bring Russia's four-year war on Ukraine to a close.@margbrennan@NikolenDC
translated_text: 新闻：特朗普政府支持一项法案草案，该法案将对俄罗斯石油购买者处以严厉的经济处罚，增加莫斯科的经济压力，所有这些都是为了结束俄罗斯对乌克兰的四年战争。@margbrennan@NikolenDC
